test_title: PYST 24: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each, in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In row 1 – M, A, R and K are seated and all of them are facing south

In row 2 – P, O, S and T are seated and all of them are facing north.

Thus each person faces another person from the other row.

T faces the one sitting to the immediate right of M. Only one person sits between T and P. Only two people sit between O and P. P faces the one sitting second to the left of K. R sits at some place to the right of A.

Which of the following options represents both people sitting at the extreme ends of the rows?
solution:
**Given**: Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each, in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In row 1 – M, A, R and K are seated
 and all of them are facing south

In row 2 – P, O, S and T are seated and all of them are facing north.

Thus each person faces another person from the other row.

T faces the one sitting to the immediate right of M. Only one person sits between T and P.

Only two people sit between O and P. P faces the one sitting second to the left of K.

R sits at some place to the right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48b3fdcbb67d1eb7b69372245fa14ec9eb978b23ad70ef759e9b4d42b70bee7e.png] 

Thus, A and O both people sitting at the extreme ends of the rows.

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
